_about: Proposed preset typical task for each job (spec 4 and 6.2), Oct 29 2026. Pages use the spec's rule: 1 page = 500 words = about 650 tokens. repeated_share is the share of pages_in that is the same text as the previous request inside the cache window (spec 5.2). 'measured_by' names the usage-run tasks closest to the preset; 'unit' says what one task means to the buyer.

writing_and_analysis.why: W1 and W2 each read about 4 pages (a quarter's sales material; an RFP plus two proposals) and write 1 to 2 pages. Only the house-style instructions repeat.

customer_service.why: Each reply re-reads the policy and the chat so far (about 3 pages) and writes about half a page. Buyers count conversations, not replies, so a task is 4 replies. Policy and earlier turns repeat within minutes, so most input is cacheable.

using_software.unit: one job done in an app, e.g. one invoice entered (about 12 steps)
using_software.why: U1 is one step: about 2.7 pages in (instructions, source email, history, current screen), a third of a page out. A full task is about 12 such steps, each re-sending the instructions and history.

building_software.unit: one bug fix or small feature by a coding assistant
building_software.why: S1 and S2 are single requests of 3.4 and 5 pages. Coding assistants usually take several requests per change, re-reading the same files, so the preset is about 4 times S2.

reading_documents.unit: one document or document set checked
reading_documents.why: R1 (annual-report extraction, 4 pages) and R2 (invoice three-way match, 1.4 pages) bracket it. Only the instructions repeat.
